text: There is a flood in our village. The water is rising fast and we need rescue boats immediately.
speaker: affected_party

text: Help is on the way. Move everyone to higher ground and stay together until the boats arrive.
speaker: first_responder

text: A child has stopped breathing and is not responding. Please send an ambulance now.
speaker: affected_party

text: Lay the child flat, tilt the head back, and give two slow breaths into the mouth every few seconds.
speaker: first_responder

text: A man is bleeding heavily from a wound on his leg and he is becoming weak.
speaker: affected_party

text: Press a clean cloth firmly onto the wound, keep him lying down, and raise the leg if you can.
speaker: first_responder

text: Many people here have severe diarrhea and vomiting, and we have no clean drinking water.
speaker: affected_party

text: Boil all drinking water, give the sick person plenty of fluids, and bring them to the nearest clinic.
speaker: first_responder

text: A pregnant woman has been in labor for many hours and is in great pain. We need a midwife.
speaker: affected_party

text: Keep her calm and lying on her side. A midwife is coming. Do not let her push until we arrive.
speaker: first_responder

text: A child has been bitten by a snake on the leg and the area is swelling.
speaker: affected_party

text: Keep the child still and the leg below the level of the heart. Do not cut the wound. Get to a hospital quickly.
speaker: first_responder

text: Armed men have entered the camp and people are hiding. We need security assistance urgently.
speaker: affected_party

text: Stay quiet and out of sight, keep the children close, and do not move until officers reach you.
speaker: first_responder
